mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.5% triggers a monetary tightening expectation, causing equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a weakening consumer demand environment, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market with unemployment rate below 4.0% and strong job growth (PAYEMS above 200k monthly), the economy is in a late-cycle expansion phase, which typically leads to rising equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 200k, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300.0 thousand units signals reduced consumer confidence in the housing market, which negatively impacts the broader economy and causes S&P 500 returns to turn negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising above 3.0%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy environment that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 250k per month indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 250k, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.
